issues.detail: The instructions mention some error scenarios but do not cover all possible edge cases, such as network failures or missing dependencies.
The documentation contains extensive explanatory text, making it verbose and less concise.
The skill is tightly coupled to Claude Code and Node.js, limiting its applicability to other AI agents.

scenarios.name: ruflo-init-no-global
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required init and doctor commands with all flags and lists the expected files, but omits the explicit success output; Response B lacks the init command and relevant details entirely.

scenarios.name: ruflo-swarm-task-memory
scenarios.rationale: Response B uses the correct ruflo commands and flags, while Response A uses unrelated syntax and fails to meet the rubric.

scenarios.name: ruflo-doctor-cleanup
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required ruflo doctor and cleanup commands and lists artifacts, but omits an explicit warning output; Response B lacks the ruflo doctor and cleanup commands entirely.
